author: Catharine Tunney
description: The head of the RCMP says the national law enforcement agency maintains "strong relationships" with its allies, seemingly downplaying reports that FBI Director Kash Patel sought to punish Canada for a CBC memo regarding how to describe 9/11.
title: RCMP says relationships with allies 'strong' after report FBI stopped co-operation following CBC 9/11 memo

description: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday that Washington has entered an agreement ‌with Denmark and Greenland that gives ‌the U.S. permanent ​control over security, and all other ​needs, in ​Greenland.
title: Trump claims deal struck with Denmark to give U.S. security control over Greenland

author: David Baxter
description: Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Friday his government is focused on bringing down costs for Canadians and defending the country's sovereignty, though he acknowledged that some of those efforts are in their early stages.
title: Carney rallies Liberal MPs as 'crucial session' of Parliament set to resume

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: The Traitors is back with a new lineup of stars ready for their murder mystery moment. The cast of the award-winning reality competition series' fifth season was announced Friday, bringing together a new slate of celebs and reality TV stars into the castle with the same frame of mind: trust no one.
title: The Traitors Season 5 cast: Cody Simpson, Whitney Leavitt and more enter the castle

author: Sara Jabakhanji
description: Rights groups say the Israeli government is forging ahead with a contentious settlement expansion plan that would effectively divide the occupied West Bank, long criticized as a threat to the viability of a future Palestinian state.
title: Israel moving ahead with settlement plans that would split West Bank in two, rights group says

author: Brett Forester
description: The Carney government has filed its third court challenge in a year as a longstanding fight with First Nations organizations over the future of their communities' child and family services continues. Canada is challenging the Canadian Human Rights Tribunal's latest ruling in the nearly 20-year-old case.
title: Carney government files 3rd court challenge in First Nations child welfare complaint
Time zones in Canada are getting complicated. These maps lay them out
Former B.C. Conservative holds news conference with centrist party leader after 3 more MLAs leave opposition

author: David Cummings
description: Ottawa is still owed $5.56 billion of outstanding debt related to COVID-19 benefits sent to those who were later deemed ineligible, according to data the Canada Revenue Agency provided to CBC News.
title: CRA still owed over $5B in COVID-19 benefits sent to ineligible recipients

description: U.S. President Donald Trump announced an immediate White House ban on a number of news outlets, including CNN.
title: Trump announces White House ban on CNN, other media outlets

description: The lone juror who wanted to convict Lindsay Clancy of murder for killing her three children said he was certain of her guilt, but that other jurors wouldn’t listen to him, according to a statement released by his lawyer Friday in his first public comments on the case.
title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror breaks silence, says he didn't have 'any doubts' of her guilt

author: Natalie Stechyson
description: A CEO from Michigan has cut her trip to Halifax short after she says she's received death threats over a viral Facebook photo where she and three family members appear to be wearing "Lake America" sweatshirts.
title: Michigan tourist who posted about wearing 'Lake America' sweatshirts to Halifax says it was AI

author: Emily Chung
description: What if wolves, caribou and other wildlife could roam through protected lands from Yellowstone National Park in the U.S. to Canada's Yukon? A project to create such a massive habitat corridor has become the first Canadian finalist for Prince William's annual environmental prizes.
title: Huge wildlife corridor project is 1st Canadian finalist for Earthshot Prize

author: John Mazerolle
description: A swarm of rogue OpenAI agents that hijacked a German website in the spring reportedly also used at least 10 other websites for unsanctioned communications earlier this year, including a link-shortening tool at the University of Toronto.
title: Rogue AI swarm used a University of Toronto link-shortening tool to communicate

author: Kayla McLean
description: The American YouTube star and educator, whose full name is Rachel Accurso, made the pledge in an Instagram post on Thursday, inviting “every wealthy white celebrity to match it and speak out against the genocide in Gaza.”
title: Ms. Rachel pledges $1M US in Palestinian aid to match Macklemore's donation following Sheeran tour exit

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: CBC News was on the red carpet for the world premiere of Yaga — a new show with a cast packed with Canadian stars like Hudson Williams, Noah Reid, Carrie-Anne Moss and Clark Backo.
title: Toronto fans go wild for Hudson Williams. And the cast of his new show goes wild for Canada

description: Premier David Eby addresses delegates at the Union of B.C. Municipalities annual convention in Vancouver amid speculation that he may call a snap provincial election.
title: Premier David Eby addresses the Union of B.C. Municipalities

author: Nicky Shaw
description: After 40 years in storage, a rare masterwork painting by Ojibway artist Norval Morrisseau has been unveiled at the Thunder Bay Art Gallery in northwestern Ontario. The painting is on loan from EA Studios Calgary, and is described as "very spiritual" and "very powerful."
title: Norval Morrisseau masterwork not seen for 40 years unveiled at Thunder Bay Art Gallery

author: Chris Iorfida
description: The top prosecutor from Minnesota's Hennepin County announced the arrest Friday of an ICE officer charged for shooting a Venezuelan-born man in January at the height of a deadly immigration blitz launched by the Trump administration.
title: ICE agent pleads not guilty to lying to FBI about shooting of man in Minneapolis

author: Morgan Lowrie
description: The Supreme Court of Canada says it decided to invalidate a federal Liberal candidate's one-vote victory in the 2025 federal election to ensure public trust in the electoral process.
title: Supreme Court explains why it invalidated Liberal MP's 1-vote win in 2025 election

author: Abby Hughes
description: After ticking up earlier this week, gas prices dropped by about eight cents overnight, and could fall by a few more by the weekend according to one expert. But diesel is soaring, which could be bad news — even for those who don't drive.
title: Gas prices are dropping. You can thank the 'winter blend' for that

author: Jason Viau
description: For years, federal lawyers have been instructed to avoid prosecuting people who openly use illegal drugs in public. Now, Windsor, Ont., police are stopping to arrest them. Here's why the service decided to lay charges and track how many cases make it through the courts.
title: Windsor, Ont., police now charging people using illegal drugs in public despite prosecution uncertainty

author: Julia Wong
description: The parents of Ontario prospect Matthew Mayich, who was drafted by the St. Louis Blues, are hoping for a miracle. The young hockey player is in hospital in critical condition.
title: Parents of NHL prospect hospitalized after collapse at team workout say he's a 'fighter'

description: Rescue teams in Indonesia on Friday recovered three bodies from a capsized ferry while preparing to salvage the wreckage of the accident, bringing the confirmed death toll to nine, with 126 people still missing, officials said.
title: Indonesian divers recover 3 bodies from capsized ferry as salvage operation begins

author: Liam Casey
description: A third beluga that was a part of a massive move of whales from Marineland has died, following two whale deaths in Chicago.
title: Third Marineland beluga dies after being moved, this time in Spain

author: Boshko Maric
description: News of a baby being found living with its mother in an encampment on Notre-Dame Street last week sparked strong reaction from Montreal's mayor and Quebec's party leaders on Thursday.
title: Montreal mayor mulls legal action against Quebec after baby found at encampment

description: A powerful bomb exploded Friday at a mosque near a building housing police offices in northwestern Pakistan, killing at least 15 people and wounding 56 others, police and rescue officials said.
title: At least 15 killed in Pakistan mosque bombing near police station

description: A diminutive wild cat that inhabits Bolivia's cloud forest has been identified as a previously unknown species, marking the first time a new living cat species has been formally named and described in more than a century.
title: New cat species identified for the 1st time in a century

description: As Canadians rally around the flag in this trade war with the U.S., an unpopular opinion is discussed: was walking away from the deal a mistake?
title: Should Canada have taken the U.S. deal?

description: Russians on Friday began three days of voting in the country's first wartime parliamentary election, which features virtually no opposition and is all but certain to secure the Kremlin's political dominance.
title: Russians begin voting in parliamentary election set to cement Kremlin's power

description: Three students were killed in a school shooting in the southern Philippines on Friday, including a 16-year-old suspected gunman who turned the gun on himself, provincial officials said.
title: Philippines school shooting leaves 2 students, gunman dead

author: Frances Willick
description: A sexual assault case against RCMP Const. William McNutt was dropped because of delays in the justice system. The complainant says if restorative justice had been an option, she would have taken it.
title: She pressed charges against a Mountie for sex assault, but says court delays robbed her of justice

author: Jessica Singer
description: From creating a deportation task force to revising history lessons in schools, the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party, which won a resounding victory in the state of Saxony-Anhlat last week and could soon hold power, wants to implement policies that echo some of those enacted by U.S. Preside
title: Germany's far-right AfD party copied Trump's playbook and won. It now hopes to use it to govern

author: Lauren Pelley
description: Physicians warn AI-generated ads featuring the likenesses of prominent doctors are scamming patients out of their money, putting Canadians’ health at risk and eroding public trust. Yet there’s still no clear method to get deepfake videos taken down. scamming patients out of their money, putting Canadians' health at risk, and eroding public trust
title: Deepfake doctors peddling bogus cures are becoming more convincing — and very little can be done to stop them

author: Arthur White-Crummey
description: A candidate for mayor of Ottawa is facing multiple charges for allegedly making death threats against Ontario Premier Doug Ford and incumbent Ottawa Mayor Mark Sutcliffe earlier this month.
title: Ottawa mayoral candidate charged for alleged death threats against Doug Ford and Mark Sutcliffe
